attackers_goals: Run as a signed Microsoft executables to avoid detection. Rundll32 is the default process used by Cobalt Strike for running post-exploitation tools.
description: Rundll32.exe is meant to run with parameters, so the absence of them is extremely suspicious; this behavior is used in the default configuration of Cobalt Strike.
investigative_actions: Check for any injection event to the Rundll32 process. Check the causality of execution for any injections.
name: Rundll32.exe running with no command-line arguments
